gloss: unprecedented and unrepeatable; the first and last of its kind

definitions.gloss: unprecedented and never to be repeated; utterly unparalleled
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) describing something so extraordinary that nothing like it has happened before ({空前|くうぜん}, never seen before) and nothing like it will happen again ({絶後|ぜつご}, none after). Usually used with の before a noun.

examples.japanese: {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|だい}ヒット→大ヒット：20827_daihitto⟧だ。
{空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: An event of unprecedented scale was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われ→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}られていない→破る：02321_yaburu⟧。
examples.english: That record is said to be unprecedented and unlikely ever to be matched, and it still has not been broken.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ meaning that something is the first of its kind and will never be matched. Composed of ⟦{空前|くうぜん}→空前：22320_kuuzen⟧ (never seen before) and {絶後|ぜつご} (never to occur again). Most often used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|だい}ヒット→大ヒット：20827_daihitto⟧: an unprecedented huge hit
- {空前絶後|くうぜんぜつご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧: a once-in-history event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧: unheard-of — stresses never having been heard of before, without the "never again" half
